applicabilityBasis.summary: CADD is a fully backed, fixed-CAD redeemable stablecoin intended for payments and settlement, so it was reviewed as an apparent payment stablecoin despite its Canadian issuance.

genius.issuerEntity: Tetra Trust Company (through CAD Digital Inc.)
genius.notes: CADD terms identify Tetra Trust Company as issuer and CAD Digital Inc. solely as its agent. Direct redemption is at CAD1 gross per token, subject to registration, sanctions checks and the greater of CAD50 or 0.25% fee. Public monthly Baker Tilly reports are present. No qualifying public GENIUS permitted-issuer approval, state qualification, pending application or foreign registration was located for CADD/Tetra Trust in the checked sources. GENIUS issuer implementation remains proposed. This pre-effective DASP status does not establish that U.S. distribution is otherwise lawful or that every customer is eligible.

sourcesChecked: Independent official-domain name search for Tetra Trust, CAD Digital and CADD with GENIUS/PPSI/enforcement/penalty terms across OCC, Federal Register, NYDFS, FDIC, Federal Reserve, NCUA, Treasury, OFAC, SEC, CFTC and FinCEN; no token-specific authorization or enforcement result located.
Issuer-domain searches on tetradg.com for GENIUS, PPSI and OCC; no indexed matching issuer intent statement located.
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, reopened CADD issuer terms and reserve disclosures, the complete OCC pending digital-asset licensing table, NYDFS regulated-entity table and issuance Greenlist, current federal implementing proposals, exact-name Federal Register API searches and official-domain searches did not identify a qualifying public GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official application or foreign registration for CADD, Tetra Trust Company or CAD Digital Inc. Tetra Trust and CAD Digital searches returned zero Federal Register records; CADD returned 25 unrelated records. No public U.S. token/issuer enforcement action was located in the specified indexed searches. These bounded findings do not exclude confidential or unindexed records and do not establish U.S. distribution eligibility.
